identity.title: [v0.92.1][PROV-C] Production-wire provider and profile hot loading

values.summary: Define a provider-only sidecar, reuse the existing watcher and candidate activation, publish immutable last-known-good snapshots, connect per-step production provider resolution, then prove atomicity redaction and shutdown.

steps.action: Define provider-only sidecar validation, snapshot identity, bounded diagnostics, and reload-owner interfaces.
Implement ProviderReloadOwner using the existing watcher and last-known-good candidate activation.
Connect the production execution runner so each inference selects and retains one immutable snapshot.
Add focused parameter capability concurrency redaction debounce and shutdown tests plus operator documentation.
Run focused Rust validation and bounded independent exact-head review.

invariants: No credential values or authority mutation
risks: Testing helper activation without production consumption
Mixing provider changes across one inference call
Leaking secret values in diagnostics or digests
Accepting executable workflow content through the sidecar
stop_conditions: The implementation requires a second watcher or provider registry
A credential value or authority-bearing object enters reload state
Production runner ownership cannot be made explicit
A partial provider snapshot can become visible
Only helper tests exist without production call-path proof
